correctness.rationale: Cap-to-cap opposite-support vertex pairs contribute n². The projected regular n-gon support intervals give 2n same-layer pairs for odd n and n for even n; vertical translation of support planes is possible for all positive h. Lateral triangle supporting normals U_j=(cos(2jπ/n),sin(2jπ/n),q), L_j=(cos((2j+1)π/n),sin((2j+1)π/n),−q), q=R(1−cos(π/n))/(2h), have exact opposite pairing in odd n and none in even n. The cited Phat local face-pair defect identity then gives δ=(2n−1)+5n odd or 2n−1 even; B follows from defining δ. Anisotropic scaling preserves opposite supporting faces. Independently checked antipodal normal angle pairing n=3..19; full numeric verifier is supporting evidence not an all-n proof.
